patthana16.54:2.1: pañca, nonatthiyā satta, nanissaye pañca, novigate satta, na-upanissaye satta, no-avigate cattāri. Hetupaccayā, nārammaṇe namagge cattāri, cattāri, . . . pe . . . nasampayutte dve, . . . nasamanantare cattāri, navippayutte dve, na-aññamaññe dve, nonatthiyā cattāri, na-upanissaye cattāri, novigate cattāri. Nahetupaccayā, ārammaṇe adhipatiyā pañca (anuloma- cattāri, gaṇanā kātabbā), avigate satta. NĪVARAṆASAMPAYUTTA-DUKAṂ niṭṭhitaṃ. 1. Nīvaraṇaṃ ceva nīvaraṇiyaṃ
